claire: Quick note from an onboarding smoke: rotor-12b-int8 shows a reproducible KV handshake mismatch at very large positions (~13.2k tokens) when we use checkpoint compression + fast-pack.

ben: short repro?

claire: repro command:
```
python tools/long_onboard.py --model rotor-12b:int8 --prompt tests/13k_manual.txt --prime-len 13200 --gen-len 400 --kv-checkpoint compression --pack fast --seed 5
```

claire: logs show a tiny tail write discrepancy on snapshot 9:
```
[INFO] kvcache: snapshot=9 tiles_written=2012 expected=2013
[WARN] packer: trailing_bits_unset=3
[DEBUG] layer=12 token=13210 v_norm_fp16=0.998 v_norm_int8=0.994
```

yusuf: trailing_bits_unset=3 suggests bit-level packing mismatch. Did we change the bitorder in the fast packer?

claire: looks like a recent micro-optim that flips byte-order for little-endian SIMD, but only in the compressed+fast path. fp16 and compressed+softpack remain OK.

ben: mitigation: add a snapshot-time assert that verifies tiles_written == expected and zero-fills trailing bits when mismatch detected. Also add a checksum footer so replay can detect the issue.

claire: agree. I'll add a non-breaking guard that zeroes trailing bits and emits metric kvcache.trailing_bits_padded. Will also run a short matrix: seeds 1-3, prime lengths 8k/10k/13k with/without compression.

ci-bot: build queued for branch "packer-endianness-guard"  artifacts s3://redwood-ci/packer-endianness-1789999999

yusuf: after guard, please run compare_kv.py replay for snapshots 0..10 into clean runtime and output per-layer max-abs diffs. If diffs persist, we'll bisect the endian micro-optim.

claire: quick results: guard applied -> trailing_bits_padded=1 on run seed=5 -> generation matches fp16 up to 14k tokens. Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-debug/rotor-endian/1789999999/

ben: good catch. Let's keep the guard for now and schedule a code review to revert/adjust the endian micro-opt unless we can prove correctness across all pack modes.

claire: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4201 (guard + telemetry + unit test). Tagging @eng-ml for review.

ci-bot: PR 4201 lint OK, unit tests passed.
